desc.en: Grass that blooms with faintly glowing flowers, as if there were a firefly inside. More developed specimens are bright enough to illuminate your hands.
desc.ja: 蛍が中に入っているかのような、かすかに光を放つ花を咲かせる草。成長したものは、手もとを照らすことができるくらい明るい

desc.en: Increases item's use count by 2. Power is reduced by a fair amount in exchange.
desc.ja: アイテムの使用回数が、２回分増加する。その代わり、威力がやや下がる
